title: Contiguous Array
summary: Find the longest contiguous piece of a binary array that has as many 0s as 1s.

tests.explain: Indices 1 to 6 hold 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0: three 0s and three 1s, length 6.
There are no 0s, so no balanced subarray exists: return 0.
The whole array has one 0 and one 1.

hints: Count a 1 as +1 and a 0 as -1. A balanced subarray is then a subarray that sums to 0.
A subarray sums to 0 exactly when the running sum before it equals the running sum at its end.
Store the FIRST index where each running sum appears (running sum 0 at index -1). When the same sum shows up again at j, j - firstIndex is a balanced length.

complexity.space: O(n): up to n + 1 distinct running sums
